name: Envious
source:
Envious is a VN based on a maid café and brothel roleplay venue in the game Final Fantasy XIV.
In this VN you play as a new hire, get to meet all of the Envious staff and see who you'll end up with! 
For lots of different reasons, unfortunately "Envious"  development had to be stopped.

[From [url=https://caracas.itch.io/envious]Itch.io[/url]]

Further development was (officially) stopped.
